fab_texts.text:
Notes on phone chassis:
- made from aluminium or similar metal
- provides heat dissipation for CM chip
- has small radiator structures (for heat dissipation)
- PCB slides or {dblquote}clicks{dblquote} into the chassis (no glue)
Flashlight LED datasheet recommends a special layout for efficient thermal dissipation
When updating PCB from schematic don't forget CAMERA and DISPLAY \ndon't have symbols (don't delete them on accident!)\n

documentation_warnings.message: No revision marking found in silkscreen. Add a revision label (e.g., 'Rev A', 'V1.0') to track board versions.
Switches without function labels on silkscreen: ['SW3', 'SW4', 'SW2', 'SW6', 'SW1', 'SW7', 'SW5']. Add ON/OFF, RESET, BOOT, or function description near each switch.
Connectors (3+ pins) without silkscreen labels: ['J4', 'J3', 'J1', 'J2']. Consider adding pin names, signal names, or connector function labels.
